subject: history
title: Indian National Movement (1885-1947)
description: Complete timeline of freedom struggle from INC formation to Independence

content.overview: The Indian National Movement was a series of events and struggles that led to India's independence from British rule in 1947.
keyPoints: 1885: Indian National Congress founded by A.O. Hume, first session in Bombay
1905: Partition of Bengal by Lord Curzon, Swadeshi Movement
1906: Muslim League founded in Dhaka
1909: Morley-Minto Reforms (Indian Councils Act)
1911: Annulment of Bengal Partition, Capital shifted to Delhi
1914-1918: WWI, India contributed significantly
1919: Rowlatt Act, Jallianwala Bagh Massacre (13 April)
1920: Non-Cooperation Movement launched by Gandhi
1922: Chauri Chaura incident, Gandhi withdrew NCM
1927: Simon Commission, Nehru Report
1928: Bardoli Satyagraha, Sardar Patel
1929: Purna Swaraj resolution, 26 January 1930 celebrated as Independence Day
1930: Dandi March (12 March - 6 April), Salt Satyagraha
1931: Gandhi-Irwin Pact, Second Round Table Conference
1932: Poona Pact between Gandhi and Ambedkar
1935: Government of India Act
1937: Provincial elections, Congress ministries formed
1939: WWII began, Congress ministries resigned
1940: Lahore Resolution by Muslim League (Pakistan demand)
1942: Cripps Mission, Quit India Movement (8 August)
1943: Bengal Famine
1945: Wavell Plan, Shimla Conference
1946: Cabinet Mission, Direct Action Day, INA trials
1947: Mountbatten Plan, Independence (15 August), Partition

mnemonics.trick: N-C-D-Q = Non-Cooperation, Civil Disobedience, Dandi, Quit India
mnemonics.explanation: Gandhi's major movements: Non-Cooperation (1920), Civil Disobedience (1930), Dandi March (1930), Quit India (1942)

mnemonics.trick: B.P. BAAD = Bengal Aage Aur Do tukde
mnemonics.explanation: Partition of Bengal 1905 — Bengal divided into two parts by Lord Curzon

mnemonics.trick: SWADESHI = S-Swadeshi use of Indian goods, W-Withdrawal of foreign goods, A-Atmanirbharta, D-Deshbhakti, E-Ekta, SHI-Shiksha & Self Respect
mnemonics.explanation: Swadeshi = Indian goods, boycott of foreign goods, self-reliance, patriotism, unity, education & self-respect

mnemonics.trick: LUCKNOW = L-League & Congress came together, U-United demand, C-Common goal self government, K-Khilafat support, NOW-New phase of unity
mnemonics.explanation: Lucknow Pact 1916 — Congress and Muslim League united, common demand for self-government

mnemonics.trick: ROWLATT = R-Repressive, O-Oppressive, W-Without trial, LA-Long duration, TT-Terror & Tyranny
mnemonics.explanation: Rowlatt Act 1919 — 'Black Act', detention without trial

mnemonics.trick: JALLIANWALA = J-Jan people, A-Amritsar, L-Lives lost, L-Lathi & bullets, I-Inhuman act, A-Against unarmed people, N-Nindaniya shameful, WALA-Place of massacre
mnemonics.explanation: Jallianwala Bagh Massacre 13 April 1919, Amritsar — General Dyer fired on unarmed crowd

mnemonics.trick: NON COOPERATION = No foreign goods, Oppose govt institutions, No titles & honours, Court boycott, Official jobs boycott, Education boycott, Rallies, Tyag (sacrifice), India's freedom mission
mnemonics.explanation: NCM 1920-22 — boycott of foreign goods, courts, schools, titles; withdrawn after Chauri Chaura (1922)

mnemonics.trick: DANDI MARCH = D-Defiance of law, A-Against British rule, N-Namak Satyagraha, D-Dandi place, I-Independence goal; MARCH = Movement Across for Rising Change
mnemonics.explanation: Dandi March 1930 — Salt Satyagraha, defiance of salt law, goal of independence

mnemonics.trick: GOVERNMENT OF INDIA ACT = G-Government of India, O-Provincial autonomy, V-Viceroy's control, E-Executive power, R-Reserved subjects, N-No full freedom, MENT-Management by British, ACT-1935
mnemonics.explanation: GoI Act 1935 — provincial autonomy but Viceroy retained control; no full freedom

mnemonics.trick: QUIT INDIA = Q-Quit India, U-Unity of Indians, I-Indefinite struggle, T-Total Freedom
mnemonics.explanation: Quit India 1942 — 'Do or Die' call by Gandhi, demand for total freedom

mnemonics.trick: JAI HIND = J-Japanese support, A-Azad Hind Fauj, I-Independence by force, H-Hope of freedom, I-India First, N-Netaji's Leadership, D-Desh ke liye
mnemonics.explanation: INA 1943 — Azad Hind Fauj led by Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose, 'Jai Hind' slogan

mnemonics.trick: 15 AUG 1947 = 1-One Nation, 5-Freedom on 15th August, AUG-August month, 1947-Year of Freedom

quiz.question: Indian National Congress was founded in:
quiz.explanation: INC was founded in 1885 by A.O. Hume

quiz.question: Jallianwala Bagh massacre occurred in:
quiz.explanation: Jallianwala Bagh massacre occurred on 13 April 1919

quiz.question: Quit India Movement was launched in:
quiz.explanation: Quit India Movement was launched on 8 August 1942

quiz.question: Dandi March was associated with:
quiz.explanation: Dandi March (1930) was part of Civil Disobedience Movement
